review_comment: User-controlled data-vimeo and data-vimeoparams attributes are directly concatenated into iframe src URLs without proper URL encoding. The patch adds this potentially vulnerable code path. Validate and encode all user input before including in URL parameters using encodeURIComponent() for parameter values and ensure parameters are properly structured to prevent injection.

The code constructs iframe src URLs by directly concatenating user-controlled parameters without proper URL encoding. While the YouTube domain provides some protection, malicious parameters could potentially cause open redirects or other client-side issues. Implement proper URL parameter encoding using encodeURIComponent() for both the video ID and parameter values before concatenation.

The code constructs JSONP URLs using user-controlled Vimeo IDs without client-side validation, creating a data injection vector. While the primary risk is mitigated by Vimeo's server-side validation, implement client-side Vimeo ID format validation using a strict regex pattern to prevent potential parameter injection. Validate that IDs contain only alphanumeric characters before template replacement.

The code includes image loading from YouTube's domain using user-controlled data-youtube attribute values without validation. While this creates a dependency on external functionality, the impact is limited to image display rather than the full domain access described in CWE-830. Validate YouTube video ID format before URL construction to ensure only legitimate video thumbnails are loaded.
